question: Which three sender (from) addresses sent the most transactions on Base (chain 8453) in the last 1 hour? Count every transaction once, including failed and system transactions. Highest count first, ties by ascending address, positive counts only.

definitions.window: The observation covers the last 1 hours ending at the latest finalized block available when requested. Resolve this once to inclusive fromBlock and toBlock; state reads use toBlock.
definitions.missing: If any required data is unavailable, inconsistent or incomplete, report inability; do not encode unknown as zero, false or an empty list.
definitions.source: Use JSON-RPC at https://mainnet.base.org for chain 8453; verify eth_chainId.
definitions.metric: Enumerate eth_getBlockByNumber(number,true) for every block. Count each transaction once by its from field, including failed and system transactions. Do not infer beneficial ownership.
definitions.ordering: Rank by descending count, tie by ascending numeric address. Return up to 3 unique addresses with positive counts. Empty only if the complete window contains no transactions.
